text: When a pet moves to a new family, its membership doesn't move by itself. Scout flags it so someone decides what happens.
Remember: Scout doesn't change anything by itself. Decide with both owners, then mark it handled.
The box says who owned Biscuit before and who owns him now, who still pays, and that billing hasn't changed.
Usually you cancel and settle with the old owner, as in the cancel video, and the new owner signs up fresh.
When it's sorted, click Mark handled.
Write what you decided. It goes on the audit trail.
Click Mark handled, and the flag clears.

The most common mistake is changing the card on file to the new owner's card without talking to the old owner. Remember: Scout doesn't change anything by itself. Decide with both owners, then mark it handled.
